title: tjvz feed manifest entry
description: One line of feed/manifest.jsonl. The feed manifest is STATE (it lives outside .tjvz/): it records which items have been surfaced to you and not yet judged, so nothing you were shown is lost when a publisher rotates it out of their RSS feed. An entry is removed once its item is promoted, dismissed, or read. It carries no score or rank: those are recomputed live on every `tjvz feed` from the current model and archive - only membership and first-surfaced time are durable. The item body itself stays in the disposable .tjvz/feeds/ cache.

id.description: The item id. The full record is in the .tjvz/feeds/ cache; look it up there.

first_seen.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first time this item was surfaced in a ranked feed. Used for 'new since last check' and for spotting stale unjudged items.
